text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you shouldn't have. Thank you<n>for the birthday
wishes!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hweh?! W-we were just about to<n>wish you happy
birthday, but now<n>you've already thanked us!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Always stay one step ahead! That's<n>the Bakushin
birthday way!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What?! Already racing into next<n>year—that's the
Bourbon speed I<n>know!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But speed happens to be my forte as<n>well! Thank
you for next next year's<n>birthday wishes!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Then happy next next next birthday.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You've done it again, Bourbon! Well<n>then, thank
you for next next next<n>next year's birthday wishes!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: How did this turn into a competition...
